title: Introducing Microsoft-Decision-1, our new model for fast decision-making. It delivers top performance on structured decision tasks, outperforming both LLMs and other decision models in latency and quality. [Read more]
summary: Introducing Microsoft-Decision-1, our new model for fast decision-making. It delivers top performance on structured decision tasks, outperforming both LLMs and other decision models in latency and quality. We’re already testing it across Microsoft for everything from incident response and quality control to scientific discovery. Available now in Foundry and soon through OpenRouter: https://lnkd.in/gNh5aW8b | 396 comments on LinkedIn
body_markdown: First Typesafe JEV, now Microsoft enters the space. It seems everyone wants a decision model—and why not? 😁 Microsoft-Decision-1 SURPRISE its Quant - QWEN! I’m incredibly impressed by the evaluation metrics for Microsoft's Decision 1; their move into this space felt inevitable. When you combine their unmatched distribution channels with the upcoming release of the Microsoft Surface RTX Spark, this decision model becomes a massive strategic win for both their short- and long-term games. Having Decision 1 running locally on a Surface RTX Spark is a pairing I would love to own, especially with a lightning fast hop to the Azure CDN and AI Foundry to complete that semi-autonomous connection. Microsoft-Decision-1, "we post trained Qwen3.5-9B" If anyone saw my last post, this was literally what I just posted with Unsloth. Satya, sir. Please tell me that you personally unsloth'd finetuned QWEN directly to a decision model, your personal multi agent setup called "LLM Council", you released at Build last year was great. 😊[https://lnkd.in/es7XSqDp](https://www.linkedin.com/redir/redirect?url=https%3A%2F%2Flnkd%2Ein%2Fes7XSqDp&urlhash=y59p&trk=public_post-text) Fine tuned Qwen3.5-9B, to a decision model post right before Satya's post, this is humbling. 👌 With all seriousness 85ms latency @ 83% accuracy for Decision-1 is remarkable.
